scientific_stage: M2-B graph identifiability diagnostic using only the frozen M2-A locally compatible candidates
purpose: Measure whether locally public-I1-compatible surrogate ambiguity changes graph-level sigma when one provider at a time is substituted away from the frozen M1 combination.

variant_design.baseline: Use the confirmed candidate with selection_role=M1 for every provider.
variant_design.alternatives: Create one graph variant for every confirmed non-M1 candidate by substituting only that provider and holding the other providers at their M1 anchors.
variant_design.rationale: One-at-a-time substitutions identify which provider-local inverse ambiguity is transmitted to graph sigma before paying for factorial composition.

graph_simulation.seed_bank_relation_to_frozen_m1_graph: Independent of the earlier Phase-3 graph bank 25000..25099.

graph_query.A_G_construction: Use the frozen public I1 A_i(rho_G) boundaries and the frozen corrected M0 deterministic G0 adapter.
graph_query.comparison_reference: BASE_M1 on the same 26000..26099 graph seed bank

reported_diagnostics.note: This stage quantifies spread without introducing a post-hoc binary threshold. Interpretation follows from the predeclared metrics.
